description: Land Title Settlement Department - Bamunawala, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420368 (23/0842)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of title determinations for multiple land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, owners, and encumbrances/mortgages, which falls squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
